_what: Why POST /api/ecommerce/checkout action=create cannot answer PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED to an external probe, measured from the bytes on the live alias rather than from a working tree.
_why_this_file_exists: The acceptance of that substitution was previously cited only inside the document that reported it. This artifact carries the measurement instead, so the claim is checkable without trusting the prose. Owner acceptance is NOT evidenced here - see ownerAcceptance below.
theBriefAskedFor: POST /api/ecommerce/checkout with action=create returns PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED, not 404

body.message: Please verify your WhatsApp number to continue.

whatIsActuallyObserved.soTheBriefsFirstHalfHolds: it is not 404 — the route exists and the function answers

whyTheLiteralStringIsUnreachable.reason: authentication precedes the body parse, so no probe reaches the action at all
inside _create, payment_readiness is evaluated BEFORE the gate, and both EXPECTED_* inputs are empty on live
whyTheLiteralStringIsUnreachable.effect: authenticated -> 409 payment_unavailable, before the gate is consulted

createOrderingOnLive._revised: A retired-provider checkout write that preceded readiness on v2 has since been removed from the handler; pricing is now a ProductsTable read, which writes nothing.

consequenceIfReadinessIsEverSetWhileTheG: every authenticated action=create would reserve a payment reference and write a PaymentAttempt row before refusing. No money moves and no gateway order is created, but the endpoint stops being inert. provision_checkout.py --verify now EXITS 1 on that combination rather than printing it.
howTheBranchIsCoveredInstead: tests/test_checkout_handler.py::test_create_disabled_prepares_attempt_but_sends_nothing_and_makes_no_order - authenticated fixture, asserts 59900 integer paise, INR, one attempt row, a PAYREF# reservation, no order keys, no send

tests/test_checkout_gate_contract.py - 5 assertions pinning the two structural facts above, the PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED branch itself, and a SUBSET check that fails when a NEW side effect appears ahead of the gate
whatWasDeliberatelyNotDone: Making the literal probe observable requires weakening authentication or reordering the handler. Both change what the endpoint does, so neither was done.

ownerAcceptance.note: An earlier revision of the closure document cited 'owner, 2026-10-01' for this substitution with no artifact behind it. That citation has been removed rather than reproduced. This file records the measurement; it does not record an approval, and no approval should be inferred from it.
